execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."platform_policy" (
  "ageVerificationDisabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text DEFAULT 'global' NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "skipAgeVerification" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "platform_policy_singleton_3422eee5" CHECK (id = 'global')
)

label: Seed platform_policy global with age verification disabled

execute.description: insert global platform_policy with ageVerificationDisabled and skipAgeVerification true
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "public"."platform_policy" ("id", "ageVerificationDisabled", "skipAgeVerification", "updatedAt")
VALUES ('global', true, true, now())
ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET
  "ageVerificationDisabled" = EXCLUDED."ageVerificationDisabled",
  "skipAgeVerification" = EXCLUDED."skipAgeVerification",
  "updatedAt" = now()

postcheck.description: verify global platform_policy has both age flags enabled
postcheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."platform_policy"
  WHERE "id" = 'global'
    AND "ageVerificationDisabled" = true
    AND "skipAgeVerification" = true
  LIMIT 1
) AS "result"
